title: Bibiyar shi daidai, gwada shi daidai, kaddamar da shi lafiya

say: Bibiyar shi daidai, gwada shi daidai, kaddamar da shi lafiya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na biyu na Tallace-tallacen da aka Biya tare da Tallace-tallacen Meta.

Yawancin yakin neman zabe ba a kashe su ta munanan tallace-tallace. An kashe su ta hanyar saiti mara kyau: asusun talla mallakar wanda ya tafi, Pixel wanda ke ƙone Siyayya sau biyu, ko katin ƙi a rana ta uku.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Saitin mara kyau yana kashe ƙarin tallace-tallace fiye da tallace-tallace mara kyau
items: Asusu mallakin ma'aikaci wanda ya tafi
Pixel mai ƙididdige siyarwa sau biyu
Kati ya ƙi a rana ta uku
Gyara tushe don haka bayanan gaskiya ne

say: Wannan tsarin yana gina tushe da kyau, don haka lambobin da kuka inganta su na gaske ne.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Saitin mara kyau yana kashe ƙarin tallace-tallace fiye da tallace-tallace mara kyau
items: Asusu mallakin ma'aikaci wanda ya tafi
Pixel mai ƙididdige siyarwa sau biyu
Kati ya ƙi a rana ta uku
Gyara tushe don haka bayanan gaskiya ne

say: Ya kamata mai kasuwancin ya mallaki fayil ɗin kasuwanci, asusun talla da Pixel. Ana ƙara ku azaman abokin tarayya, ba a taɓa ba su kalmar sirri ba, kuma idan kun tafi suna adana komai.
Kunna tantancewar abubuwa biyu ga kowa da kowa, tare da amintattun admins guda biyu. Gwada hanyar biyan kuɗi, tabbatar da Pixel da yankin, kuma saita iyakacin kashe kuɗin asusu azaman hanyar tsaro.

panel.heading: Saita da lissafin aminci
items: Fayil na abokin ciniki
Abu biyu akan, admins biyu
An gwada hanyar biyan kuɗi
An tabbatar da Pixel da abubuwan da suka faru
An tabbatar da yankin
An saita iyakacin kashe kuɗi

say: Meta Pixel ƙaramar lamba ce wacce ke aika abubuwan da suka faru, kamar ƙara zuwa cart ko siya, zuwa Meta. Buɗe abubuwan gwaji, sannan bincika rukunin yanar gizon ku. Kowane taron ya kamata ya bayyana a cikin daƙiƙa guda.

panel.heading: Duba cewa Pixel ɗinku ya faɗi gaskiya
items: Buɗe Gwaji a cikin Manajan Events
Yi lilo, ƙara zuwa cart, fara biya
Duba shafuka tare da Meta Pixel Helper
Sanya odar gwaji mara ƙima ta gaske
Ƙara API ɗin Canje-canje, ID na taron iri ɗaya

say: Duba kowane shafi tare da Meta Pixel Helper kyauta akan kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka. Sannan sanya odar gwaji mara ƙarancin ƙima kuma mayar da shi.

say: Masu sauraron al'ada sune mutanen da suka riga sun san ku. Sake mayar da mutanen da suka ƙara kan keken kaya a cikin kwanaki 14 da suka gabata amma ba su saya ba.

panel.heading: Ba Meta sigina masu dacewa
items: Retarget: ƙara zuwa cart, bai saya ba

say: Kuma keɓance abokan ciniki na yanzu, don haka ku daina biyan kuɗi don nuna musu tayin oda na farko.

say: Mai kamanni yana tambayar Meta don nemo mutanen da suka yi kama da tushe. Yana buƙatar aƙalla mutane 100 daga ƙasa ɗaya, kuma abokan cinikin ku mafi kyawun maimaita 600 sun doke mutane 5,000 waɗanda suka taɓa son rubutu. Loda lissafin abokin ciniki yana buƙatar izininsu.

say: Babban niyya yana aiki mafi kyau da zarar Pixel ɗin ku yana da tarihin siyan. Amma wuri ya kasance mai wuyar doka. Idan a Legas kawai za ku kawo, saita Legas.

say: Dole ne jarrabawar ta canza abu ɗaya kawai, farawa da rubutaccen hasashe, ya sami isasshen kasafin kuɗi, kuma ya yi aiki na ƙayyadadden lokaci. Ruth tana so ta gwada bidiyon zanga-zanga akan carousel da ke jagorantar farashi.

card.title: Shin kasafin kuɗi ya isa a gwada?

say: Kusan Naira 4,000 ne aka siya. 30 kowacce iri tana bukatar 60, wato naira 240,000, kimanin 17,100 a rana a cikin kwanaki 14.

card.title: Shin kasafin kuɗi ya isa a gwada?

say: Naira 8,000 kacal abokin ciniki yake da shi a rana. Wannan yana siyan sayayya 14 kacal a kowane sigar, kaɗan ne don amincewa.

card.title: Shin kasafin kuɗi ya isa a gwada?
rows: Kasafin gwajin yau da kullun na abokin ciniki

say: Don haka sai ta gwada a kan add to cart maimakon naira 900 kowanne. Wannan yana ba da kusan 62 a kowace sigar, sannan ta tabbatar da wanda ya ci nasara akan sayayya daga baya.

card.title: Shin kasafin kuɗi ya isa a gwada?
rows: Kasafin gwajin yau da kullun na abokin ciniki

say: Karanta Ka'idodin Talla na Meta ga kowane abokin ciniki. Kwafi wanda ke nuna kun san wani abu na sirri, kamar gwagwarmaya da nauyin ku, ana ƙi. Don haka yi tabbataccen sakamako na lafiya ko kyakkyawan sakamako, tayin arziki da maɓallan karya.

panel.heading: Sake rubuta shi kafin Meta ya ƙi shi
right: Shirin namu yana taimakawa mutanen da...
Da'awar gaskiya, NAFDAC idan an buƙata
Kanun labarai ya faɗi menene tallan

say: Rubuta: shirinmu yana taimaka wa mutanen da. Ci gaba da da'awar gaskiya, tare da rajistar NAFDAC inda samfur ke buƙata. Idan karya ne na gaske, gyara shi, saboda maimaita cin zarafi na iya taƙaita duk asusun talla.

say: Gudanar da rajistan kafin farawa akan wayar kowane lokaci. Sa'an nan kuma a cikin sa'o'i na farko, duba kawai don kurakurai: yana bayarwa, yana kashewa akan hanya, duk wani ƙin yarda?

panel.heading: Saka idanu da wuri, yanke shawara daga baya
items: Sa'a 2: yana bayarwa?
Ranar 1: ciyarwa da kurakurai
Kwanaki 2 zuwa 7: kashe hannu
Ranar 7: kwatanta da CPA manufa
Ranar 14: yanke shawara

say: Bar shi kadai yayin koyo. Daga ranar 7, kwatanta kowane tallace-tallace da aka saita tare da farashin kuɗin da kuke so a kowane tallace-tallace. Watch for m kasala: mita hawa yayin da dannawa faduwa. Gyaran sabon abu ne.

say: Lokacin da saitin talla ya buge manufa, ɗaga kasafin kuɗinsa a matakai masu sauƙi, ba sau biyu ba. Rubuta kowane canji a cikin log ɗin canji, tare da kwanan wata da dalili, kuma aika bayyanannen rahoton mako-mako wanda ke jagorantar umarni, kudaden shiga da farashi kowane oda.

panel.rule: Haɓaka kasafin kuɗi kusan kashi 20 cikin ɗari a lokaci ɗaya.

say: Don tunawa. Abokin ciniki ya mallaki kowane kadara. Tabbatar da cewa Siyan yana gobara sau ɗaya. Yi amfani da masu sauraro na al'ada don sake farawa da ware. Gwada canji ɗaya tare da isassun abubuwan da suka faru. Kuma duba kowane ƙaddamarwa akan wayar, kuma shigar da kowane canji.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Abokin ciniki ya mallaki kowane kadara
Sayi gobara sau ɗaya, tabbatarwa
Sake kunnawa kuma keɓe tare da masu sauraro na al'ada
Maɓalli ɗaya, isassun abubuwan da suka faru, ƙayyadaddun ranaku
QA akan waya; log kowane canji

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Saita kuma tabbatar da Pixel akan wurin aiki da yin rikodin abin da ke gobara. Zana masu sauraro da shirin gwaji tare da lissafin kasafin kuɗi. Sannan gina lissafin binciken ku na QA wanda za'a sake amfani dashi, tsarin sanya suna, canza log da samfurin rahoto.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Yi rikodin tabbatarwa na Pixel
Zana masu sauraro da shirin gwaji
Gina QA ɗinku da kayan bayar da rahoto
